# Packr — Design Notes

## Source Template

- **ColorLib Name:** Suitcase
- **Slug:** suitcase
- **Preview URL:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/suitcase/
- **Screenshot:** https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/suitcase-free-template.jpg

## Replication Notes

- Preview was reachable; HTML + CSS fetched and analyzed
- Font: Inconsolata (monospace) from Google Fonts
- Brand color: #0e27fb (blue) — used as primary throughout
- Hero uses full-width background images with dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.3))
- Services use icon cards in 3-column grid
- Portfolio uses 2-column grid with hover overlay effect
- Blog uses featured image + 4-post grid layout
- Counters use IntersectionObserver for scroll-triggered animation
- Testimonials use centered cards with photos
- Footer has 3-column layout: brand, newsletter, social links
- Social icons (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Dribbble) are inline SVGs (brand icons removed from lucide-react)
- All images use picsum.photos seeded placeholders
